column6: Streams from NE horizon to zenith; brilliant crimson near zenith
Veil purple-red to yellow-white; streams centering at zenith; with mirage
Reprint Boston Patriot; purple-red veil, nearly moonlight bright
Variegated streaks horizon to zenith, as much light as rising sun
Reprint NY Courier; blazing-sun corona near zenith, pale reddish rays
Reprint Boston Transcript; purple veil, light enough to read print
Reddish coruscations WNW to ESE spanning the sky
Streamers, shadows cast, dark southeast; letter of a few days earlier
New Orleans Bee described aurora of the 3d; place unclear
